name: B10-0277/2025 – After § 2 – Am 14
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: 2a. Calls for the abandonment of the EU electricity market, which exposes the Member States to artificial price volatility disconnected from the physical realities of national energy mixes; calls for the complete decoupling of electricity prices from gas prices, and for a clear preference for stable and dispatchable energy sources, such as nuclear energy;
